description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag (ShopProductImageUrlTag) that generates a URL for product images based on product SKU, image name, and size. It constructs the URL considering the merchant store's domain, configuration settings, and image size (small or large).

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that generates the URL for product images based on SKU, image name, size, and store configuration.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Main method that constructs and outputs the image URL based on request, session, and tag attributes.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Returns EVAL_PAGE to continue processing the JSP page.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Setter for size property, indicating image size (SMALL or LARGE).
